intro.headline: From buyer PO to supplier-ready order

outro.headline: Send every purchase order in the format each supplier needs.

beats.vo: ProcuLink turns buyer purchase orders into supplier-ready orders.
beats.shot: Short brand opener followed by the current upload workbench.

beats.vo: Orders can arrive by upload, email, API, SFTP, or S3. Every path lands in the same review flow.
beats.shot: Show the more-ways-to-ingest rail on the upload page.

beats.vo: For the walkthrough, start with a sample order and jump straight into review.
beats.shot: Use the sample order CTA instead of lingering on the file picker.

beats.vo: Source, normalized data, and supplier output stay connected. The queue shows only exceptions that can block delivery.
beats.shot: Current approved three-column order workshop; do not redesign it.

beats.vo: For an unresolved item, ProcuLink suggests the supplier code with confidence and evidence. Accept it when it is right.
beats.shot: Accept one real mock AI suggestion and show the issue count decrease.

beats.vo: When you know better, enter the value yourself. Saving the mapping makes the same buyer-to-supplier match reusable on the next order.
beats.shot: Enter a supplier item code, save, and show the line resolved.

beats.vo: Supplier rules check required fields, totals, mappings, and output readiness before anything is sent.
beats.shot: Readiness and validation area with a truthful ready state.

beats.vo: Preview exactly what the supplier will receive. The configured template controls the structure, field mappings, format, and delivery channel.
beats.shot: Switch to full document or supplier output preview with readable output.

beats.vo: When the order is ready, ProcuLink generates the artifact, sends it, and reports the transmission result.
beats.shot: Confirm send and show generating, sending, then delivered transmission state.

beats.vo: The audit trail records changes, generated output, destination, and result. The original source remains intact.
beats.shot: Current delivery log and order audit proof, without implying business acceptance.

beats.vo: Review exceptions. Control output. Send every supplier the order they require. ProcuLink.
